Chapter 429 - 429 Shock; Cooperation! (1)

Chapter 429 - 429 Shock; Cooperation! (1)

429 Shock; Cooperation! (1)

Lin Fan and Feng Zhixiang had interacted many times.

He had a good impression of this old man who worked hard for the country’s scientific and technological development.

Therefore, without much hesitation, he pressed the answer button.

“Professor Lin, you submitted Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets to Nature?”

Feng Zhixiang’s urgent voice sounded as soon as the call was connected.

“Yeah,” Lin Fan said slowly.

“Gaming helmets… can they really be made?” Feng Zhixiang asked nervously.

Lin Fan said, “Sure, I’ve been playing with one for a few days.”

“Playing… How many days have you been playing?” Feng Zhixiang stuttered.

Then, he asked in disbelief, “You mean…”

Lin Fan said, “Yes, I’ve already invented it.”

“Good, good, haha! That’s great!” Feng Zhixiang laughed happily. “Professor Lin, where are you? I’ll be right there!”

“Coiling Dragon Villa. You’ve been here before. Do you still remember the location?” Lin Fan said.

“I remember, I remember. I’ll be right there!” Feng Zhixiang said.

Then, Lin Fan heard the sound of a collision from the phone.

“I’ll take full responsibility. I’ll compensate you for your car now…”

Lin Fan slowly placed his phone down and muttered, “Feng Zhixiang… got into a car crash? He shouldn’t be so agitated at his age!”

Lin Fan shook his head and returned to his room. He put on the gaming helmet and entered World game again.

In the game, Lin Fan was riding a white horse. He welcomed the breeze and galloped on the green grassland.

At this moment, a huge claw suddenly stretched out from the ground in the distance.

Lin Fan’s expression was calm as he pulled out the blade from his waist and swung it fiercely.

The claw broke.

At the same time, a golden pearl of light appeared on the ground.

This was the treasure that appeared after killing the monster.

However, Lin Fan did not care at all.

Instead, he continued to ride his horse forward.

This was because he had experienced too many things like killing monsters and obtaining treasures in the past few days. There were some things that he did not even bother to pick up.

…

When Lin Fan took off his gaming helmet, it was already a few hours later.

He got up from the bed and stretched.

At this moment, the doorbell rang urgently.

Hearing this, Lin Fan came to the front of the door and slowly opened it.

“Professor Lin, so you’re really home?” Feng Zhixiang said excitedly.

At this moment, he was covered in sweat and looked rather disheveled.

Lin Fan was stunned. “When did you arrive?”

“About two hours,” Feng Zhixiang said.

Lin Fan could not help but reveal an awkward look.

He thought that Feng Zhixiang would only come in the afternoon.

Who would have thought that he would come so quickly?

Two hours?

In other words, he had been standing outside for two hours?

It had been a long time.

Lin Fan said, “Come in and drink some water.”

Feng Zhixiang waved his hand and said, “No need… Where’s the gaming helmet you mentioned just now?”

“In the bedroom,” said Lin Fan.

Thus, the two of them went to the bedroom together.

Feng Zhixiang held the metal helmet and asked, “This… is the gaming helmet?”

Lin Fan nodded.

Feng Zhixiang was even more excited.

He could not help but carefully examine the gaming helmet.

Then, he asked, “Can I try?”

Lin Fan nodded and helped Feng Zhixiang put it on his head.

Feng Zhixiang only felt the back of his neck tighten slightly.

In the next moment…

He appeared on the beach.

In the distance, there were surging waves.

He raised his head… he could see the scorching sun.

Feng Zhixiang stuttered, “This… This… Weren’t I in the Coiling Dragon Villa just now, trying out the gaming helmet?

“Am I dreaming?”

At this moment, a large crab suddenly crawled over to Feng Zhixiang’s feet and pinched his toes.

“Ah!

“It hurts!

“I actually feel pain! This is not a dream!”

Then, Feng Zhixiang held up the seawater and put it into his mouth.

“Salty!”

…

About ten minutes later, Feng Zhixiang took off his gaming helmet.

His face was full of surprise as he sighed sincerely. “Unbelievable, this is too unbelievable!

“After I put on the gaming helmet, I even thought that I had transmigrated!”

As he spoke, Feng Zhixiang could not help but hug the gaming helmet tightly.

It was as if he was holding a supreme treasure.

Supreme treasure?

In Feng Zhixiang’s heart, this was much more precious than countless supreme treasures!

It was because Feng Zhixiang understood that this gaming helmet was definitely a revolutionary invention!

It would definitely cause the entire world to shake again!

“Professor Lin, can you let us study this helmet?” asked Feng Zhixiang.

Lin Fan was not surprised by such a request. He nodded and said, “Sure.”

“Thank you, Professor Lin. I’ll come back in two days to borrow your gaming helmet!” Feng Zhixiang said excitedly.

Lin Fan could not help but ask, “Aren’t you going to Jingbei now?”

After all, every time he studied something in the past, he had to bring it to the capital immediately.

“No need,” Feng Zhixiang said with a smile. “A while ago, we applied for a scientific research institute in Jiangbei. In the next two days, some academicians and various equipment will be shipped over.”

Lin Fan nodded his head.

Feng Zhixiang said, “Oh, right. Professor Lin, are you planning to cooperate with Dahua Group to produce the gaming helmet?”
